name: nop-indieweb/photos
title: Photos
description: The post's photos (else its featured image) at full height, one at a time: swipe or step between them, and open one full size in the lightbox. Ratio fixes their shape ("1" for square), cropping to it. Map adds the post's map (check-in or route) as the last slide, after the photos. Layout: a strip (one at a time, for the overlay) or a grid (all of them, composed: one large and the rest beside it, for the post's own page).
